novelty_claim: none; controlled replication and application study

model_study.question: On book-domain field tasks with identical per-task input evidence and total student-training allowance, how do joint adaptation, specialists and merged specialist encoders trade held-out accuracy, coverage and selection/deployment cost?
claims_excluded: causal effect of output type from one dataset per type
book mood validity from Reddit emotion scores
source taxonomy labels are complete negatives
literature recommendations demonstrate accuracy gains on LexiMind
model_study.head_initialization: identical task-specific initialization within each matched training seed

tasks.target: Book genre and topical-subject fields, kept as separate label families
Highlighted-character emotion in a literary passage; auxiliary to future reader-mood work
tasks.integration_status: requires_character-conditioned input and reviewed label mapping; no whole-book mood output
tasks.annotation_policy: Review t0 character validity and t1 response semantics. Blank/uncertain responses remain unknown, not neutral or all-negative; retain annotator disagreement.

budget.boundary: synchronized forward, backward and optimizer window; transfers, compilation, evaluation, selection and failures logged separately

model_study.checkpoint_selection: final budget checkpoint primary; any validation-selected checkpoint is a separately declared secondary analysis
unresolved: catalogue facet mapping and reviewed positive/negative labels
CR4 schema, character context, source terms and human/derived label separation
hardware feasibility, B, sampling and equal selection allowance
held-out book evaluation and protocol freeze
model_study.unadapted_reference: Excluded for private classifiers: random new heads are not a meaningful unadapted baseline. A frozen-encoder trained-head control would require its own declared budget.

supervision_policy.known_metadata: copy sourced bibliographic/explicit catalogue values; learn missing fields separately
supervision_policy.publisher_and_catalogue_labels: source-specific silver supervision, not complete truth
supervision_policy.unknown_targets: mask unknown labels; do not manufacture negatives
supervision_policy.negative_evidence: reviewed negative or complete-label seed set required; positive-only masked BCE is not sufficient
supervision_policy.hierarchy: only reviewed implications; preserve source taxonomy before field mapping
supervision_policy.split_unit: work/edition/series reconciliation across all tasks and sources before partitioning
supervision_policy.input_parity: all recipe arms use the same allowed evidence for each task
supervision_policy.evidence: store source references and spans; span presence does not certify model reasoning
supervision_policy.prediction_policy: calibrate per-field thresholds on held-out works and report precision/coverage; allow abstention

optional_controls.role: optional out-of-domain topic control, not primary book supervision
optional comment-emotion control, not literary or reader mood gold
optional generation control, not mandatory for book field accuracy

model_study.optional_domain_adaptation: Later teacher-free denoising on permitted training-book text only; one identical adapted initialization across recipe arms, with cost recorded. Not started.

applied_study.question: Which source-backed representations improve graded query-to-work relevance within an explicitly eligible catalogue?
applied_study.catalogue_population_claim: current curated catalogue only; not a representative population sample
applied_study.unjudged_policy: primary scoring requires complete judged eligibility; null is abstention, never zero
applied_study.pool_conditional_scores: secondary only, with frozen pool definition and coverage reported
unresolved: complete relevance judgments or frozen pooled secondary design
query-family and seed-work partitions over the fixed catalogue
field_priority: reader mood only after independent book-domain evidence
reader_affect_candidates: independent reader-experience collection informed by acrec
claims_excluded: target-book review-derived requests are prospective human requests
character/passage emotion directly labels whole-book reader mood
